articles.title: C. elegans Study Reveals Cellular Defense Against Drug-Induced Lysosomal Damage — Implications Pharma Doesn't Want Discussed

This is the kind of mechanistic drug-harm research that should be front-page news but instead sits buried in a nematode biology journal.

Whether this non-patentable finding makes it into obstetric practice or gets quietly shelved is the real test of whether evidence drives medicine.
